level 119) chathead.png|left]] |version9 = [[File:Vampyre Juvinate (Sins of the Father) chathead.png|left]] }} '''Vampyre Juvinates''' are a class of [[vampyre]] above [[Vampyre Juvenile]]s that can be found in the woods east of [[Burgh de Rott]], outside [[Ver Sinhaza]] in [[Meiyerditch]], and in [[Darkmeyer]]. Former humans who have been turned into vampyres, juvinates are an "initiated juvenile" who have received some training and are starting to get some powers.{{CiteNPC|npc=Meiyerditch citizen|quote=They're initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to get some powers.|loc=|notes=|name=}} They can only be harmed by silver weapons or with [[Efaritay's aid]], and like juveniles, they become [[mist]] and retreat at 25% or lower health unless they are held with the [[special attack]] of the [[Rod of Ivandis]], [[Ivandis flail]], [[Blisterwood flail]], or [[Hallowed flail]]. They can then be given a dose of [[Guthix balance]], at which point they may die instantly (16% chance, rewards 100 [[Prayer]] experience and drops [[vampyre dust]]), become a [[feral vampyre]] (16% chance), or return to their human form (68% chance){{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Ash|url=https://discord.com/channels/324132423636090880/431834766325841920/1483061226853503017|date=2026-03-16|quote=Aside from the ones that always die like you noted, it's 16% instant die, 68% turn human, 16% get angry, with no chance modifiers.|image=|ctximage=|ctxquote=|notes=|name=}} and give the player a reward. If a juvinate turns to mist, they will say "Ha, ha, ha, time to disappear and rejuvenate!" before disappearing. Juvinates cannot be killed by any means other than with a Guthix balance; even if they are reduced to 0 hitpoints, they will still turn to mist instead of dying. When successfully returning a Juvinate to human in [[Burgh de Rott]] or during [[Temple Trekking]], they will turn into [[Benjamin]], [[Liam]], [[Miala]], or [[Verak]] and hand the player a noted reward. If the Juvinate was returned to a human in [[Meiyerditch]], a [[Former Vampyre]] will appear instead. Juvinates in [[Darkmeyer]] cannot be cured or turn into feral vampyres, but rather always die instantly. ==Prayer info== {{Prayer info |name = Vampyre Juvinate |level = 1 |xp = 100 |xpnote = Only upon
